description_en: Modifies the backup policy settings of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于修改RDS实例的备份策略设置
name: ModifyBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。可调用DescribeDBInstances获取
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The backup type. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
备份类型，取值：

DataBackupPolicy：数据备份
LogBackupPolicy：日志备份
parameters.name: backup_policy_mode

parameters.help_en: The time at which to perform the backup task. Format: HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ (UTC). This parameter is required when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy. This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh: 执行备份任务的时间。格式：HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 BackupPolicyMode为DataBackupPolicy时，该参数必传。 仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: preferred_backup_time

parameters.help_en: The backup cycle. You must specify at least two days. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
备份周期。至少需要指定2天，多个取值用英文逗号（,）隔开。取值：
Monday：周一
Tuesday：周二
Wednesday：周三
Thursday：周四
Friday：周五
Saturday：周六
Sunday：周日

与BackupInterval参数共同决定备份策略。例如：本参数指定周六周日备份，BackupInterval参数指定30分钟，则在每周的周六和周日每隔30分钟执行一次备份。
BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时，该参数必传。
仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: preferred_backup_period

parameters.help_en:
The number of days for which data backups are retained. Valid values: 7 to 730.

This parameter is required when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy.
This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
数据备份保留天数，取值：7~730。

BackupPolicyMode为DataBackupPolicy时，该参数必传。
仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable log backup. Valid values:

Enable: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled.

For ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances, log backup is enabled by default and cannot be disabled. However, you can modify the log backup frequency as follows:

Log backup frequency of every 5 minutes: Set BackupLog to Enable and leave LogBackupFrequency empty (no value required). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2861729.html. This configuration is not supported when a preferred secondary database for backup is specified (BackupPriority is set to 1). Otherwise, an error is returned.
Log backup frequency of every 30 minutes: Leave BackupLog empty (no value required) and set LogBackupFrequency to LogInterval.
Log backup frequency consistent with data backup: Leave BackupLog empty (no value required) and leave LogBackupFrequency empty (no value required).

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy and is used to enable or disable log backup
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启日志备份。取值：

Enable：开启。
Disabled：关闭。

对于SQL Server实例，日志备份默认开启，无法关闭，但您可以修改日志备份频率，具体如下：

日志备份频率为每5分钟一次：BackupLog设置为Enable，LogBackupFrequency为空（无需传值）。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2861729.html。**该配置不支持在设置了优先备库（BackupPriority为1）时使用，否则将会报错。**
日志备份频率为每30分钟一次：BackupLog为空（无需传值），LogBackupFrequency设置为LogInterval。
日志备份频率为与数据备份一致：BackupLog为空（无需传值），LogBackupFrequency为空（无需传值）。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为DataBackupPolicy时生效，用于开启或关闭日志备份
parameters.name: backup_log

parameters.help_en:
The number of days for which log backups are retained. Valid values: 7 to 730. The value cannot be greater than the number of days for which data backups are retained.

When log backup is enabled, you can specify the retention period of log backup files. Currently, only MySQL and PostgreSQL instances support this parameter.
This parameter takes effect when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy or LogBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
日志备份保留天数。取值：7~730，且不大于数据备份保留天数。

当开启日志备份时，可设置日志备份文件的保留天数，目前仅支持MySQL和PostgreSQL实例设置该值。
BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy或LogBackupPolicy时都适用
parameters.name: log_backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable log backup for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB instances. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL、PostgreSQL、MariaDB实例是否开启日志备份。取值：
True或1：开启。
False或0：关闭。

SQL Server实例日志备份默认开启，无法关闭。因此SQL Server实例无需关注此参数。
该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为LogBackupPolicy时生效，用于开启或关闭日志备份
parameters.name: enable_backup_log

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable point-in-time recovery for a MySQL instance. Valid values:
True: Enabled.
False: Disabled.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy and BackupLog is set to Enable. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2666046.html
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL实例是否开启任意时间点恢复。取值：
True：开启
False：关闭

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy且BackupLog为Enable时生效。功能详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2666046.html
parameters.name: enable_pitr_protection

parameters.help_en:
The number of hours for which binary logs are retained on the MySQL instance. Valid values: 0 to 7×24. A value of 0 indicates that binary logs are not retained locally.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to LogBackupPolicy. In this case, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL实例日志备份本地保留小时数。取值：0~7*24，0表示不保留。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为LogBackupPolicy时生效，且此时该参数必传
parameters.name: local_log_retention_hours

parameters.help_en: The maximum usage of the local log storage space for a MySQL instance. If the usage exceeds this value, the system starts to delete binary logs from the earliest one until the usage drops below this value. Valid values: 0 to 50. By default, this parameter is not modified
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL实例本地日志最大循环空间使用率，超出后，则从最早的Binlog开始清理，直到空间使用率低于该比例。取值：0~50。默认不修改。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为LogBackupPolicy时生效，且此时该参数必传
parameters.name: local_log_retention_space

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to unconditionally delete binary logs when the storage usage of a MySQL instance exceeds 80% or the remaining storage is less than 5 GB. Valid values: Enable | Disable. By default, this parameter is not modified
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL实例使用空间大于80%，或者剩余空间小于5 GB时，是否无条件清理Binlog。取值：Enable | Disable。默认不修改。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode为LogBackupPolicy时生效，且此时该参数必传
parameters.name: high_space_usage_protection

parameters.help_en:
The log backup frequency of an SQL Server instance. Valid values:
LogInterval: every 30 minutes.
Empty (no value required): every 5 minutes or consistent with the data backup frequency.

This parameter takes effect only when the BackupPolicyMode parameter is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server实例的日志备份频率，取值：
LogInterval：每30分钟。
空（无需传值）：每5分钟备份一次或与数据备份一致。

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: log_backup_frequency

parameters.help_en:
The backup compression method. Valid values:
0: No compression.
1: zlib compression. The backup file is in the tar.gz format.
2: Parallel zlib compression.
4: quicklz compression. The backup file is in the xb.gz format. This value is applicable only to MySQL 5.6 and MySQL 5.7. This compression method can be used for https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/103175.html.
8: quicklz compression. The backup file is in the xb.gz format. This value is applicable only to MySQL 8.0. Individual database and table restoration is not supported.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
备份压缩方式。取值：
0：不压缩。
1：zlib压缩，格式为tar.gz。
2：并行zlib压缩。
4：quicklz压缩，格式为xb.gz。仅适用于MySQL 5.6/5.7，此备份压缩方式可用于https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/103175.html。
8：quicklz压缩，格式为xb.gz。仅适用于MySQL 8.0。暂不支持单库单表恢复。

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: compress_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of days for which archived backup files are retained. Default value: 0, which indicates that archived backup is disabled. Valid values: 30 to 1095.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
归档备份的保留天数。默认为0，表示未开启归档备份。取值：30~1095。

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: archive_backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en: The retention cycle for archived backups. The number of backups that can be retained within this cycle is determined by ArchiveBackupKeepCount. Default value: 0. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
归档备份的保留周期，该周期内能保存的备份个数由ArchiveBackupKeepCount决定。默认为0。取值：
ByMonth：月
ByWeek：周
KeepAll：全部保留

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: archive_backup_keep_policy

parameters.help_en:
The number of archived backups to retain. Default value: 1. Valid values:
If ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy is set to ByMonth, the value ranges from 1 to 31.
If ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy is set to ByWeek, the value ranges from 1 to 7.

If ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy is set to KeepAll, you do not need to specify this parameter.
This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
归档备份的保留个数。默认为1。取值：
当ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy为ByMonth时，取值为1~31。
当ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy为ByWeek时，取值为1~7。

当ArchiveBackupKeepPolicy为KeepAll时，本参数无需传入。
仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: archive_backup_keep_count

parameters.help_en: The data retention policy for archived backups of deleted MySQL instances. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL已删除实例的归档备份保留策略。取值：
None：不保留
Lastest：保留最后一个
All：全部保留

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效。
2024年02月01日及之后新购的RDS MySQL云盘实例ReleasedKeepPolicy默认值为Lastest；高性能本地盘实例默认值为None。功能详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2836955.html
parameters.name: released_keep_policy

parameters.help_en:
The number of binary log files retained locally. Default value: 60. Valid values: 6 to 100.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to LogBackupPolicy.
If the instance type is MySQL, you can set this parameter to -1 to retain an unlimited number of local binary log files
parameters.help_zh:
本地Binlog保留个数。默认为60。取值：6~100。

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为LogBackupPolicy时生效。
如果实例类型为MySQL，可以传入-1，即不限制本地Binlog的保留个数
parameters.name: log_backup_local_retention_number

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable backup within seconds. Valid values:
Flash: Enabled.
Standard: Disabled.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启秒级备份。取值：
Flash：开启
Standard：关闭

仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The snapshot backup frequency. Valid values:
15: 15 minutes.
30: 30 minutes.
60: 60 minutes.
120: 120 minutes.
180: 180 minutes.
240: 240 minutes.
360: 360 minutes.
480: 480 minutes.
720: 720 minutes.

This parameter works together with the PreferredBackupPeriod parameter to determine the backup policy.
The MySQL instance must be a High-availability Edition or Cluster Edition instance that uses cloud disks and runs MySQL 5.7 or 8.0.
The PostgreSQL instance must be a cloud disk instance.
The SQL Server instance must have https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211143.html enabled.
This parameter is invalid when the Category parameter is set to Flash.
This parameter takes effect only when the BackupPolicyMode parameter is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
快照备份频率。取值：
15：15分钟。
30：30分钟。
60：60分钟。
120：120分钟。
180：180分钟。
240：240分钟。
360：360分钟。
480：480分钟。
720：720分钟。

与PreferredBackupPeriod参数共同决定备份策略。
MySQL实例必须是云盘5.7、8.0 高可用系列、集群系列实例。
PostgreSQL实例必须是云盘实例。
SQL Server实例必须已开启https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211143.html。
Category参数为Flash时本参数无效。
该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: backup_interval

parameters.help_en:
The backup method for SQL Server instances with cloud disks. Valid values:
Physical (default): physical backup.
Snapshot: snapshot backup.

This parameter takes effect only when BackupPolicyMode is set to DataBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server云盘版实例的备份方式。取值：
Physical（默认值）：物理备份
Snapshot：快照备份

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: backup_method

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable incremental backup for SQL Server instances with cloud disks or MySQL instances with local disks. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server云盘版、MySQL本地盘实例是否开启增量备份。取值：
False（默认）：关闭
True：开启

该参数仅在BackupPolicyMode参数为DataBackupPolicy时生效
parameters.name: enable_increment_data_backup

parameters.help_en: The high-frequency incremental backup frequency for MySQL instances with local disks. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL本地盘实例高频增量备份频率。取值：
60：60分钟。
120：120分钟。
240：240分钟。
360：360分钟。
720：720分钟。

该参数仅在EnableIncrementDataBackup参数为True时生效
parameters.name: inc_backup_interval

parameters.help_en: The setting for https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95717.html of SQL Server Cluster Edition instances. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server集群版实例https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95717.html的设置选项。取值：
1：优先备库
2：强制主库
 
仅当BackupMethod取值为Physical时，该参数才生效。如果BackupMethod设置为Snapshot，SQL Server集群版实例将强制在主库备份。
设置优先备库（BackupPriority为1）后，不支持开启5分钟日志备份策略（BackupLog为Enable且LogBackupFrequency为空），否则将会报错。请将日志备份频率设置为每30分钟一次或与数据备份一致
parameters.name: backup_priority

parameters.help_en: The EnableAdvancedBackupPolicy
parameters.help_zh: The EnableAdvancedBackupPolicy
parameters.name: enable_advanced_backup_policy

parameters.help_en: The AdvancedDataPolicies
parameters.help_zh: The AdvancedDataPolicies
parameters.name: advanced_data_policies

parameters.help_en: The AdvancedLogPolicies
parameters.help_zh: The AdvancedLogPolicies
parameters.name: advanced_log_policies

CompressType.description_en:
The backup compression method. Valid values:
0: not compressed.
1: zlib compression.
2: parallel zlib compression.
4: quicklz compression with database and table restoration enabled.
8: MySQL 8.0 quicklz compression without database and table restoration support
CompressType.description_zh:
备份压缩方式，取值：
0：不压缩。
1：zlib压缩。
2：并行zlib压缩。
4：quicklz压缩，开启了库表恢复。
8：MySQL8.0 quicklz压缩但是还未支持库表恢复

EnableBackupLog.description_en:
Indicates whether log backup is enabled. Valid values:
1: Enabled.
0: Disabled.

Log backup is enabled by default for SQL Server instances and cannot be disabled
EnableBackupLog.description_zh:
是否开启日志备份。取值：
1：开启
0：关闭


SQL Server实例日志备份默认开启，无法关闭

HighSpaceUsageProtection.description_en: Indicates whether binary logs are unconditionally deleted when the storage usage of a MySQL instance exceeds 80% or the remaining storage is less than 5 GB
HighSpaceUsageProtection.description_zh: MySQL实例使用空间大于80%，或者剩余空间小于5 GB时，是否无条件清理Binlog

LocalLogRetentionHours.description_en: The number of hours for which instance log backups are retained on the local storage of a MySQL instance
LocalLogRetentionHours.description_zh: MySQL实例日志备份本地保留小时数

LocalLogRetentionSpace.description_en: The maximum loop space usage of binary logs for a MySQL instance
LocalLogRetentionSpace.description_zh: MySQL实例本地日志最大循环空间使用率

LogBackupLocalRetentionNumber.description_en: The number of local binary logs retained for a MySQL instance
